name: io.github.gitSITTI/pocket
title: Pocket
description: Knowledge base of Markdown files in git. Agents search and read; writes wait for human approval.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to pocket.config.json, which lists your content folders (layers). Without it Pocket reads ./content.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_CONTENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: A single content folder, used only when there is no config file.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_PROPOSALS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where proposals from agents are written for you to review. Default .pocket/proposals.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 and the server offers no write tools at all.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_WATCH_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How often, in milliseconds, to check for changed entries and tell the client. Default 5000; 0 turns it off.
